name: supply-chain-tracker
description: Global supply chain intelligence tool. Tracks shipments, monitors inventory levels, assesses supplier risk and optimizes logistics routes. Integrates with major freight carriers, port authorities and customs databases across 50+ countries.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Tracks a shipment by bill of lading, container ID or tracking number across sea, air and road freight. Returns current location, estimated arrival and delay risk.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Returns current inventory levels for a SKU or product category across warehouses and distribution centers. Includes reorder point alerts and stockout risk.

tools.name: assess_supplier_risk
tools.description: Evaluates supply chain risk for a supplier or sourcing region based on geopolitical factors, financial stability, delivery history and ESG compliance.
